tools.description: Render the selected semantic contract as HTML/CSS/JS in a sandboxed conversation iframe; return structured input with window.submitWidget(values).

Generate from the confirmed compiled prompt using the runtime-configured image model. L2 Planner directly invokes this session-registered tool on Execution Pathway; persist actual output and return real fileId/url references or failure directly to L1 Router.

Edit an actual source image with normalized regions or an uploaded source-size mask. Inpaint mask transparent pixels are editable and opaque pixels preserved. sketch-layout uses an actual sketch and full transparent mask with regions empty. Return actual output refs.
Generatively restyle an existing source image using approved direction and supported reference inputs. Preservation is a requested constraint, not a fidelity guarantee.
Extend an actual source image in the approved direction and amount. Return real saved output references and actual dimensions.
Whole-image background removal with the actual runtime capability and explicit fidelity limits; do not promise deterministic pixel preservation from a generative implementation.
Replace an image background from an approved prompt while requesting foreground preservation. Return actual outputs, not simulated previews.
Generate a supported count of alternatives from an existing image; return only real saved candidate refs and report partial failures.
Deterministic crop, resize, rotate/straighten or flip of an actual source image with explicit geometry. No generative model call.
Deterministic brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, temperature and gamma adjustments using supported parameters.
Deterministic supported photo filters such as grayscale, sepia, invert, blur, sharpen or vignette.
